title: Verify workflow reuse with real provider and approved replay
summary: Completion success alone does not prove workflow assessment or execution; test provider wire compatibility, scoped handoff and approved input variants.
reusable_steps: Completion success alone does not prove workflow assessment or execution; test provider wire compatibility, scoped handoff and approved input variants
expected_outcome: The live workflow reuse probe found two blockers hidden by mocked model tests: no governed LLM profiles were passed, and arbitrary ADF dictionary output was rejected by the provider strict schema. Pass the schema-validated wisdom policy into the adaptive runner. Transport ADF as JSON text, parse it safely and retain internal schema, ADF, guardrail and dry-run validation. Confirm candidate identity is stable for unchanged evidence. Treat generation and static validation separately from execution: human project-trust approval was required, then A/B/A and an additional output-visible B run succeeded with four ok traces. The synthetic logging candidate is evidence, not a product template. This record is curated from live evidence; mission distillation used structural fallback after an unrelated optional experience field returned null.
